# Collapse

A button that opens and closes a region elsewhere on the page - help under a toolbar, more filters, the details of a row - by the library's own command, `--toggle`. A closed region is `hidden="until-found"`, so the browser's find in page still reaches its words and opens it. A section that opens under its own header is an [accordion](accordion.md).

## Examples

The button carries `command="--toggle"`, names its region in `aria-controls` and says in `aria-expanded` whether the region is open: write it as the region starts, and the library keeps it. It takes no `commandfor`: WebKit would then tell a screen reader the button is collapsed whatever its `aria-expanded` says.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="collapse-help-text" aria-expanded="false"><i class="bi bi-question-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>How prices work</button>
</div>
<div id="collapse-help-text" hidden="until-found">
	<p class="text-muted">A price is per person. Children from four to eleven pay the child price; under four they travel free.</p>
</div>
```

### Open from the start

A region without `hidden` starts open, its button `aria-expanded="true"`.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="collapse-open-filters" aria-expanded="true"><i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>More filters</button>
</div>
<div id="collapse-open-filters" class="hstack flex-wrap gap-8">
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true">With lunch</button>
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Private</button>
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Sunset</button>
</div>
```

### A chevron and words that follow

Inside a button with `aria-expanded`, an icon `toggle-chevron` turns over while the region is open, `toggle-open` shows only then and `toggle-closed` only while it is closed - by CSS alone, from the state the button already says.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="collapse-chevron-text" aria-expanded="false"><span class="toggle-closed">Show the route</span><span class="toggle-open">Hide the route</span><i class="bi bi-chevron-down toggle-chevron" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
</div>
<div id="collapse-chevron-text" hidden="until-found">
	<p class="text-muted">The pier at 08:30, the emerald lake at 11:00, lunch on Koh Mae Ko, back by 17:00.</p>
</div>
```

### A details row in a table

A row under a row opens and closes the same way: the region is a `<tr>` with one cell across the table. A table's row cannot be hidden "until found", so it starts as plain `hidden` and closes so again; find in page does not open it.

```html
<table class="table" aria-label="Deleted records">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col">When</th><th scope="col">What</th><th scope="col"><span class="visually-hidden">Details</span></th></tr></thead>
	<tbody>
		<tr>
			<td class="tabular-nums">12:40</td>
			<td>3 excursions</td>
			<td class="text-end"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-text" type="button" command="--toggle" aria-controls="collapse-row-details" aria-expanded="false">Details</button></td>
		</tr>
		<tr id="collapse-row-details" hidden>
			<td colspan="3">Ang Thong, Koh Tao and the sunset cruise, with their photos and reviews.</td>
		</tr>
	</tbody>
</table>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On the button |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens or closes the region; every button for it says the new state |

- Find in page opens a closed region on a match where the browser has `hidden="until-found"` - Chrome, Firefox 148 and Safari 26.2 on - and the library marks its buttons open; in older browsers the region stays closed until its button opens it.
- Put the region right after its button in the reading order, or name it, so a reader who opens it finds it.
- From script: `region.hidden = false` opens it - set `aria-expanded` on its buttons yourself then.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapse` | - | state | closed: hidden="until-found" on the region; open: no hidden; its button has command="--toggle" |
| `collapse-horizontal` | - | review | not planned: a region opens downward, in its place |
| `collapsing` | - | remove | the region opens at once |
| `data-bs-toggle="collapse"` | `command="--toggle" aria-controls="ID" aria-expanded="false"` | trigger | the region is hidden="until-found" while closed; in an accordion the item is a <details> |
| `bootstrap.Collapse` | `region.hidden = false` | review | and setAttribute('hidden', 'until-found') to close; set aria-expanded on its buttons then: a button with command="--toggle" does both |
